notes.subject: to Isirayɛl
notes.rationale: Kumasen in bɛ wele Isirayɛl ka jama fɛ — 'aw' nɔnabila bɛɛ kɔnɔ.

notes.subject: מנדריכם/ונדבתיכם
notes.rationale: Neder (layidu) ni nedava (yɛrɛ-ɲinini) — daɲɛ ninnu fila bɛ danfara bɛɛ la: min labɛnna, min donna yɛrɛ fɛ.

notes.subject: במועדיכם
notes.rationale: Dunaw (mɔgɔdɔnniyaw) jatew bɛ sariya kɛ — Sariya Numara 28–29 donjatew ka labɛn ye.

notes.subject: hɛrɛ-sarakaw
notes.rationale: שלמים kɔrɔ ye 'sarakaw minnu bɛ hɛrɛ walima ɲɔgɔnya ɲɛ' — hɛrɛ ta.

translation: Nin sarakaw, aw bɛ u di Yawe ma aw dunaw ɲɛ, aw layiduw ni aw yɛrɛ-ɲinini sarakaw kɔrɔ, aw sankolo-sarakaw kama, aw kisɛ-sarakaw kama, aw minɛ-sarakaw kama, ani aw hɛrɛ-sarakaw kama.
